prompt: Using a materially different reviewer-held local multi-host simulation, diagnose unsafe inventory selection, a critical variable collision, non-idempotent rendering, a broken handler and a failing canary health gate. Repair the design, demonstrate convergence and defend a production rollout without lesson answers.
deliverables: Exact controller, source, dependency and configuration identity.
Resolved inventory topology and approved-versus-actual host-set comparison.
Critical-variable provenance table including every source, precedence class, winner and authorized owner.
Task/handler graph and first causal defects distinguished from later symptoms.
Minimal reviewed patch with deterministic state, validation and honest change/failure semantics.
Initial convergence, immediate zero-change second run, drift prediction, repair and reconvergence.
Canary/batch design aligned with simulated failure domains and shared dependency capacity.
Configuration, process, service and user gates with explicit abort and rollback thresholds.
Security analysis covering controller, collection, connection, become, decrypted secret and artifact surfaces.
Observability event model correlating revision, host, task, batch, handler, service and user evidence.
Exact rollback of authoritative desired state and guarded cleanup evidence.
Five-minute product-company incident briefing plus delayed changed-case transfer.
evidenceRequirements: Reviewer fixture differs in host/group names, variable sources, template defect and failure ordering from LES-0040.
No remote host, root, real secret, network endpoint, external collection or cloud object is permitted.
Every raw output is bound to revision, version, path and UTC time and contains no synthetic secret canary.
At least one broad limit and one higher-precedence override must be rejected rather than used.
A failed initial hypothesis must be preserved and corrected using evidence.
The health gate must stop later batches despite successful Ansible task results.
Reviewer observes exact cleanup and a delayed case with changed inventory topology.

rubric.observableEvidence: Pins source, controller, core, Python, config and dependencies.
Resolves and bounds exact hosts with rejection guards.
Explains sources, winner, authority and validation.
Separates selection, rendering, handler and health defects.
Uses deterministic state-aware implementation without hiding failures.
Proves first/second run, prediction, repair and fixed point.
Batches respect redundancy, capacity and dependency limits.
Independent gates stop rollout and authoritative rollback reconverges.
Protects identity, privilege, dependencies, secrets and artifacts.
Concise uncertainty-aware briefing and changed-case success.
